name: com.tl.ui
description: Engine-free UI timeline clips and rules for Tl. Show, Hide, Enable, Disable, Add Class, Remove Class and Attach clips switch UI targets by Id while they are on; Animate and Text clips drive channels that can hold; Signal and Focus clips raise events. Pure rules turn the columns into a look per target and report what changed, so any engine host applies only the difference. Builds as a .NET project against Tl.Core alone.
